subject.title: fix: open selected channel setup immediately

question: Should a channel-only `openclaw channels add <channel>` or `--channel <channel>` invocation remain picker-first as documented, or should OpenClaw introduce an explicit opt-in mode for immediate setup?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a public interactive CLI workflow rather than repairing a defined broken behavior; only maintainers can choose whether the reduced confirmation step is the desired permanent user contract.

options.title: Preserve existing selection semantics
options.body: Keep positional and `--channel` selection picker-first, retaining the documented guidance and confirmation behavior.

options.title: Add explicit direct entry
options.body: Retain existing behavior and introduce a clearly named opt-in flag for users who want to start the chosen channel’s setup immediately.

options.title: Adopt the breaking behavior
options.body: Accept immediate entry as the new default and document the upgrade behavior, including that Back is now required to reach the picker.

recommendation.title: Add explicit direct entry
recommendation.body: Retain existing behavior and introduce a clearly named opt-in flag for users who want to start the chosen channel’s setup immediately.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored the current channel-setup routing proposal and is best positioned to incorporate the chosen interface direction.
